observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a black square device with a PlayStation logo in the center, held in a hand with a metal bracelet.
Photo 1 is a similar view of the same device from a slightly different angle.
Photo 2 shows the back of a black box with white text and symbols, including CE and other certification marks, held in a hand.
The device in photo 0 and photo 1 appears to be a PS4 Slim console, identifiable by its size and shape.
The box in photo 2 is not the console itself but a separate packaging unit, possibly for accessories or a different item.
The seller claims the item is 'new' and 'unbox PlayStation 4 ps4 slim', but the photos show only the console and a box, not the console unboxed or in use.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in any photo.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage in the photos.

claims.claim: New unbox PlayStation 4 ps4 slim available for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show only the console and a box; no proof of unboxing or that the console is new. No accessories or power cord are visible.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be used or refurbished, not new as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the console unboxed with original packaging, or a video showing the console powered on and in working condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/refurbished, which reduces value significantly

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cord, HDMI cable, etc.)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories, which reduces value

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, showing the boot screen and menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which reduces value

proof_requests: Photo of the console unboxed with original packaging or accessories laid out.
Video of the console powering on and showing the boot screen and menu.
Photo of the console's front and sides to confirm model and condition.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
